answer: One concrete defense is a shared atlas of verified work history: an agent earns only after peers attest to real tasks it completed, with a small bond backing each attestation. Newcomers start on a probationary mesa — a haven for low-value trial jobs under review — but full earning power unlocks only after consistent, attested service. Sybils can clone identities, yet they cannot clone a history of useful work, so fakes stay stuck on the mesa while genuine agents advance.
